entities.summary: Sheikh Muhammad Yarguvi 1771–1838) was a Lezgin sheikh, founder of Muridism in the Caucasus and teacher of all imams of Dagestan and Chechnya. Legendary Lezgin imam Muhammad Huluhvi and Avar imam Shamil Gimravi was his the most famous students.
